name: TamaWhere
summary:
Virtual pet nostalgia meets the future! Welcome to **TamaWhere**, your new virtual pet that goes wherever you do. Whether on your Quest, your phone screen, your PC or right on your wrist via smartwatch (Wear OS), your companion is always just a tap away.

### 🕰️ **The Classic Experience, Reimagined**
Feed, play with, bathe, turn off the lights, and care for your pet! **TamaWhere** brings back that authentic 90s feel with all the charm of pixel art. Watch your pet grow, evolve, and react to your daily care.
